page.title: Business details
page.ordering_body: Orders are placed on this site at least 24 hours before the delivery or pickup time. Before payment you see the products, the date and time, and the final total.
page.prices_body: The prices shown are final prices. The delivery fee depends on the delivery city and is shown before payment.
page.delivery_body: Deliveries are made by the business's courier to the cities offered at checkout. You can also pick up the order yourself.
page.payment_body: Payment is by Bit or PayBox, through a link shown after you order. Write the order number in the payment note. The order is confirmed once the payment is received.

errors.not_found_body: The page you were looking for does not exist.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.whatsapp_prefill_order: Hi, I have a question about order {orderNumber}

exemption_notice.title: Cancelling an order
exemption_notice.catalog: Fresh food product: the order cannot be cancelled after it is confirmed, under the Consumer Protection Law.
exemption_notice.custom_cake: Made especially for you: a custom cake cannot be cancelled after the order is confirmed, under the Consumer Protection Law.
exemption_notice.before_payment: Until you pay, you can still cancel the order: contact us by phone or WhatsApp.
exemption_notice.defects: This does not affect your rights if a product is defective.

notice.title: How we use your details
notice.collected_data: {businessName} uses the details you enter here (name, phone and, for delivery, address) and is the owner of the database.
notice.purpose_checkout: They are used to carry out your order and coordinate the handover.
notice.purpose_registration: They are used to manage your account and show your orders. Marketing messages are sent only if you tick the separate box.
notice.purpose_custom_cake: They are used to review your custom cake request, set a price and carry out the order.
notice.recipients_uncle: For a delivery, your name, phone, address, time window and delivery notes are passed to the business's courier. The data is stored with hosting providers outside Israel.
notice.photos: Inspiration photos are seen only by the baker, are never published, and are deleted after the order.
notice.retention: You are not legally required to give these details, but without them we cannot carry out the order. Retention periods and your rights:

privacy.notes_hint: No need to write medical information here. For allergy questions, call us.

page.title: Privacy notice
page.intro: This notice explains which details we collect when you order, why, who receives them, how long we keep them and what your rights are.

owner.title: Who owns the database
owner.body: The database is owned by the business below. You can contact us about your details by phone or email.

collected.title: What we collect
collected.name: Name.
collected.phone: Phone number (required, to coordinate the order).
collected.address: Street address and city, for delivery only. Not collected for pickup.
collected.email: Email, optional, to send you the order confirmation in writing.
collected.notes: Order notes and delivery notes you choose to write.
collected.inscription: Cake inscription text (it sometimes includes a child's name and age).
collected.photos: Inspiration photos for a custom cake.
collected.profile_dates: For registered customers who want benefits: birthday and anniversary (day and month only, no year). Optional.

not_collected.title: What we do not collect:
not_collected.payment: Payment details (you pay directly in Bit or PayBox).
not_collected.location: GPS location. We do not use analytics or advertising tracking.

obligation.title: Do you have to give these details?
obligation.body: There is no legal obligation. Without a name, phone and (for delivery) an address we cannot carry out the order.

purposes.title: What the details are used for
purposes.account: Managing a registered account and its order history.
purposes.marketing: Marketing messages (benefits, promotions, a birthday greeting with a benefit) only if you ticked the separate consent box. You can unsubscribe at any time.

recipients.title: Who receives the details
recipients.courier: The business's courier, for deliveries only: name, address, phone, time window and delivery notes. Not the items, prices or inscription.
recipients.hosting: Infrastructure providers: Netlify (website hosting) and Supabase (database and photos).
recipients.email: Resend (sending email), if you gave an email address.
recipients.whatsapp: WhatsApp (Meta), when the business contacts you on WhatsApp.
recipients.receipts: The business's receipts software, if your name is written on a receipt.

abroad.title: Transfer abroad
abroad.body: The providers above store the data on servers outside Israel.

retention.title: How long we keep the details
retention.orders: Identifying details on an order (name, phone, address, email, notes, inscription): {months} months after the order is completed, then deleted and the order is anonymized.
retention.financial: Items, amounts and dates of an order, without identifying details: for the period required for accounting.
retention.photos: Inspiration photos: {days} days after the order is completed, declined or expired, then deleted.
retention.profile: A registered profile: until you delete it, or after {months} months without activity, with notice 30 days in advance.
retention.consent: Records of marketing consent and its withdrawal: kept as evidence of consent.
retention.pending: These periods are pending confirmation by the business's accountant.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.access: To see the details we hold about you (answer within 30 days).
rights.correction: To ask us to correct details that are wrong.
rights.marketing: To be removed from marketing messages at any time, by the link in any message or by asking us.
rights.registered: Registered customers can also download their details and delete their account. To use any of these rights, contact us by phone or email.

photos.title: Inspiration photos
photos.body: Photos you upload for a custom cake are seen only by the baker, for making your cake. They are never published and are deleted {days} days after the order.

health.title: Health information
health.body: No need to write medical information in the notes. For allergy questions, call us.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: The site uses only essential cookies (keeping you signed in). No analytics, advertising or third-party cookies, so there is no cookie banner.
